red.head: 4c5cde427049dd4c499cce2728a2d4442c6fc7df
red.evidence: All existing checks passed through secret scan; GWC-4 read-only safety tests failed because src/governedWorkflow/adapters/session.ts did not exist.

selfReview.finding: M1 EvidenceRef non-conformance: digest was null for digestible Session/Receipt/ConnectionContext observations; receipt/session bindings omitted known github head; ConnectionContext reference was not sufficiently authority-rereadable.
selfReview.correction: EvidenceRef now carries canonical SHA-256 content digest, known headSha where available, and a governed-session-scoped ConnectionContext reference.

behavior: GW-02/GW-03/GW-12/GW-16/GW-17 are pure observation wrappers over existing connection/session/receipt authority outputs
wrappers never create, resume, acknowledge or otherwise mutate a session and never infer authorization
AutoResumeCompatibleSessionInput and GovernedOperationalContext repository projection accept a generic owner/repository target type
persisted GovernedSessionRecord, BootstrapReceipt and ConnectionContext schemas remain exactly Patricked-code/MCP until GWC-10 target migration
OPENED/ATTACHED/RESUMED/NONE/AMBIGUOUS semantics are preserved; NONE/AMBIGUOUS are never silently resolved
bootstrap MISSING/CURRENT/STALE/EXPIRED freshness is preserved without upgrade
context acknowledgement wrapper fails closed unless session and receipt prove the same stateVersion
contract/graph digests are carried only in orchestration metadata, not persisted into the receipt
EvidenceRef satisfies M1 digest/binding requirements and never exposes resume secrets or raw transport identifiers
implementation.authorityBoundary: Governed Session Service, Operational Memory store and Bootstrap Receipt remain the sole lifecycle/persistence/freshness authorities; no second session engine or receipt exists.

nextAction: Mark GWC-PRE-E-GWC-5 READY now that GWC-4 is complete; keep GWC-PRE-E-GWC-6 READY; execute GWC-5 first by nominal sequence.
